content.question: How does the epsilon-greedy algorithm balance exploration and exploitation?
options: It chooses the best known action most of the time, while occasionally selecting a random action.
It strictly alternates between a random action and the best known action on every step.
It chooses randomly until the first reward is received, then never changes its behavior.
It always selects the action with the highest epsilon value.
content.answer: It chooses the best known action most of the time, while occasionally selecting a random action.
